title: Parish and Portrait
author: Gideon Okafor
blurb: August Villalobos, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
